title: Cooked Eggs!!!
description: Small mod that adds cooked eggs into your game.
body:
Small mod that adds cooked eggs into your game.
This mod is great for servers and single player that need more food options.

The mod is very small so it will not cause any lag to your modded experience.

Currently you are only able to cook chicken eggs but soon you will be able to cook turtle and sniffer eggs.

Feel free to use this in servers and any modpacks.
